release_safety: Keep historical RDS/H5/labels. Write new outputs and decision logs. No automatic global reannotation or cell deletion.
counts_input: Unintegrated raw RNA nonnegative integer sparse counts with explicit cell and full-feature axes
annotation_reference_policy: Frozen immune reference model checks plus canonical markers; High/Low are related references, not independent validators. Keep conservative coarse labels and fine unresolved/review flags.

integration_benchmark.space: high-dimensional PCA or learned corrected embeddings, not 2D UMAP
integration_benchmark.source_permutation_guard: Explicit unique cell IDs and numerical reorder before attaching reductions
integration_benchmark.biology_validation: Independent source/reference and marker/pseudobulk evidence; own method clusters are not ground truth
integration_benchmark.batch_objective: Balance batch removal and biology preservation; never force disease/tissue-specific states to mix

pilot_diagnostic.metric: unweighted kNN study inverse-Simpson diversity, explicitly not LISI

study_design_gate: Catalogue condition is not clinical case-control status. Tissue/source-confounded hypotheses need matched donor/visit/covariate design or must remain descriptive.
statistical_unit: Verified source donor/independent biological specimen with repeated visits grouped. Cell-level labels/scores are not independent donor replicates.
cell_cycle_policy: No unconditional regression/removal of cycling biology. Any compared nuisance regression requires a documented biological-preservation diagnostic.
